info.about: Death Crimson OX is a light gun shooting game developed by Ecole Software. It was released in arcades in 2000 then ported to the Dreamcast console in 2001, several months after Sega had dropped support for the console.
info.trivia: It is the third and final Death Crimson game and the only one released outside Japan.
info.why: Sammy released it in North America several months after Sega had dropped support for the Dreamcast, so it shipped into a shrinking market.
